text: Unitree Robotics closed at 845 yuan in its Shanghai debut, over 460% above its offer price after rising nearly 630% intraday. The humanoid and quadruped robot maker raised about 6.1 billion yuan in its IPO, with DeepSeek among participating investors.

meta.note: First-day pricing limits separation of durable valuation structure from listing-specific demand.

text: Target's Q2 net sales rose 5.3% and comparable sales 3.8%, with all six major categories growing. Net earnings included a $752 million tariff refund. Digital comparable sales rose 8.7%, while apparel and home lagged other categories.

meta.note: The tariff refund separates reported earnings from the quarter's underlying operating result.
